Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1150
Claimant:
Mallory Carter
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
August 2, 2024
Claim opened after a low-speed collision in a shopping center parking lot. The claimant reports a knee injury and says
she was seated in the vehicle when it was struck while backing out of a space. The claimant is not represented by an
attorney.
September 10, 2024
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Photos
from the scene show the rear quarter panel damage described by the other driver.
October 9, 2024
Other driver's statement mtaches the account given by the cliamant and the witnesses on how the accident
happened. The driver is confirmed as a household member of the policyholder and is covered under the policy.
December 17, 2024
Claimant was contacted by phone and repeated the same account of the collision, including the sequence of events
and where she was seated. No inconsistencies noted between this call and the initial report.
December 27, 2024
Claimant reports knee pain starting the same day, with the injury consistent in location and force with the impact
described. No prior injury to the same knee is known from available records.
January 9, 2025
Medical records show treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and reduced visits as the claimant's
knee improved. Treatment appears to be tapering off at this stage.
January 15, 2025
Vehicle inspection found no earlier damage to the vehicle, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the
coverage start date. It is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact, so the repair estimate is
being reviewed line by line.
January 25, 2025
Claim is pending completion of the damage review and final medical summary. Current findings support the accident
occurring as reported, and the file is being routed for settlement evaluation once the open items are closed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
